patches_modified.name: Clean main UI
patches_modified.description: Hides the bottom navigation bar, the top-right guide icon, and the Rate/Help/About drawer items, keeps the connect/create/join buttons on top, and stops them from being auto-hidden. Reapplied on create, resume, and drawer open (and retried for ~1.8s after each) since some of these views are inflated lazily.

patches_added.name: Disable downloader from download menu
patches_added.description: Strips RsDownloadActivity's file-extension and scheme/mimeType intent filters so it no longer offers itself as a handler in the system download/"complete action using" chooser.

patches_added.name: Disable rate us dialog
patches_added.description: Overrides show() on the in-app "rate us" dialog so it's still built but never displayed.

patches_added.name: Clean SnapTube Settings Page
patches_added.description: Removes the Download tools and Phone clean categories, and their sub-items, from Settings.

patches_added.name: Disable Annoying Snaptube Notifications
patches_added.description: Turns off the Toolbar, Recommended contents, and Tool notifications channels by default.
